description: two-dimensional lid-driven square cavity at Reynolds number 700, uniform 128x128 mesh
context: Steady incompressible laminar flow: two-dimensional lid-driven square cavity at Reynolds number 700, uniform 128x128 mesh. Solved with OpenFOAM simpleFoam using standard SIMPLE pressure-velocity coupling; with SIMPLE the pressure under-relaxation factor is usually kept well below 1, roughly one minus the momentum factor. The run stops once every equation residual is below its convergence target. Goal: reach convergence in as few iterations as possible without oscillation or divergence. The momentum (U) under-relaxation factor acts like a pseudo time step: larger values give faster progress but less stability.
